sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 4** across Father Patrick Peyton's *Family Theater* hosted by J. Carrol Naish (1947) and Roddy McDowall (1957), RCA's flagship international variety broadcasts on *The Magic Key of RCA* (1938, 1939), Westinghouse science educator Dr. Phillips Thomas on *Adventures in Research*, and jazz retrospectives on *Turn Back the Clock*, J. Carrol Naish & Roddy McDowall (1947, 1957), Frank Black (1938, 1939), Dr. Phillips Thomas (1951), and *Family Theater* (1938–1959):
